# Blueprint — $1–10M ARR

## Signals
- $1–10M ARR; first reps hired; playbook still forming.

## Focus first
- Write the sales playbook yourself and prove reps hit 3x OTE.

## Do not focus on
- Scaling headcount before the ramp model is proven.
- Leading with the product instead of the need.

## Benchmarks
- Rep on $250K OTE → ~$750K new bookings.

## Exit criteria
- Standardized playbook; reps consistently at ~3x OTE.
